support-ops: [1748005432] Hi team — customer "NordVault" in EU submitted a DPA erase for tenant tv-789. They report top-level API returns 200 but our erase job shows partial failures: KMS rewraps returning 403 for some conversation keys, and billing still shows token usage during the window. Legal needs verifiable deletion evidence + timeline. ticket#9876 :rotating_light:

alex: I'm on it. Can you paste the exact error blob and confirm which deployment this is (hosted/dedicated/private)?

support-ops: Snippet from erase job logs (sanitized):
```
2025-04-05T12:31:02Z erase_job[tv-789] DELETE s3://redwood-oss/kv/tv-789/conv-1234 -> started
2025-04-05T12:31:03Z kms:Rewrap -> status=403, code=AccessDenied, key=projects/eu1/cmk/abc-xxx
2025-04-05T12:31:03Z erase_job status=partial_failure
```

deployment: hosted-eu-west-1. Customer says they see 200 for the API but per-conversation rewrap fails. Billing spike visible 12:30-12:35.

jordan: 403 on Rewrap usually means our service principal isn't authorized for that CMK or a grant was removed. Could also be HSM-level handshake failures surfacing as AccessDenied. @leo can you check the CMK mapping for tv-789?

leo: tv-789 -> CMK arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:alias/tv-789-cmk status=ENABLED. No scheduled rotation in last 30 days. But I do see HSM provider logs around 12:29 showing repeated HSM_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT then retries; finally KMS returned AccessDenied. Could be transient or a grant change.

sasha: Customer needs per-object deletion proof and KMS audit entries. What's the playbook to produce a legally acceptable bundle?

mike: Legal needs: (1) per-object deletion timestamps + checksums, (2) KMS CloudTrail entries with request IDs and principal, (3) confirmation backups/replicas are EU-only. Tag me when bundle ready.

alex: Repro plan: 1) dry-run erase for tv-789 to list targets 2) run erase for a single conv (conv-1234) with debug to capture KMS request/response 3) collect CloudTrail KMS ReEncrypt/Delete calls. I'll run step 1 now.

sre-bot: deploy started by alex at 2025-04-05T12:40Z — debug-erase(tv-789, conv-1234) queued on host rwd-erase-02

alex: Dry-run output: 42 objects queued, conv-1234 included. Re-running for conv-1234 only.

alex: Re-run produced:
```
kms:Rewrap requestId=abcd-1234 status=403 detail="PrincipalNotAuthorized" principal=service/redwood-erase@redwood-prod
```
PrincipalNotAuthorized points at a missing grant or key policy issue for that alias.

leo: Key policy looks standard. I see a grant retire event at 2025-04-05T12:28 that removed a temporary grant used for rewraps during rolling upgrades — matches timeline. Restoring grant now.

leo: Done. Restored grant id=grant-77b. Re-run the limited erase.

alex: Re-run after grant restore -> success. KMS Rewrap returned 200 and erase for conv-1234 completed. Collected CloudTrail entries: requestId abcd-1234 then efgh-5678 (success). Uploading artifacts to secure bucket rwd-legal-audit/tv-789/erase/2025-04-05/

sasha: Customer informed. They still see billing entries for the 12:30 window — is that expected?

mike: Billing can reflect retries and queued compute. Legal will want a timeline showing when token consumption stopped and correlation to successful erase. Also include any retry/billing caused by failed KMS ops.

alex: Found metric slice: the partial_failure triggered our retry loop which re-enqueued ~6 deletion tasks causing compute token consumption from 12:30-12:36. I'll produce per-route token counts and correlate to erase job attempts. Will include in audit bundle.

jordan: Action items: (1) infra to investigate grant-rotation automation and why it removed an in-use grant, (2) confirm HSM handshake retries don't mask auth errors. Filing INF-489.

anita: I'll add a pre-check in the grant-rotation job to detect active in-flight operations and a short-lived "hold" state. Also add a clear fail-fast state to the erase workflow so we return explicit "waiting for grant" instead of silent retries.

support-ops: Owners & ETA — leo: restore grants + HSM debug; alex: audit bundle + billing correlation; anita: grant-rotation fix; jordan: INF-489; mike: legal bundle delivery. ETA for the audit bundle: 3 hours.

mike: For EU residency confirmation, we need explicit confirmation that backups/async replicas for tv-789 are in eu-* regions only. If any replication reached outside EU via a sub-processor, we must request delete evidence from that sub-processor. @partners-bot FYI.

partners-bot: Notifying partners-team channel about potential subprocessor involvement.

support-ops: Will post secure bucket link to ticket once ready. :white_check_mark:
